result.stdout:
Description:
  Download Pwned Passwords hash ranges for offline use.

Usage:
  haveibeenpwned-downloader [<outputFile>] [options]

Arguments:
  <outputFile>  Name of the output. Defaults to pwnedpasswords, which writes hash ranges to a directory called pwnedpasswords. Use --single to write pwnedpasswords.txt instead. [default: pwnedpasswords]

Options:
  -p, --parallelism <parallelism>  The number of parallel requests to make to Have I Been Pwned to download the hash ranges. If omitted or less than 2, defaults to eight times the number of processors on the machine. [default: 0]
  -o, --overwrite                  Overwrite existing files while writing the results.
  -s, --single                     Write the hash ranges into a single .txt file instead of individual files in a directory.
  -n, --ntlm                       Fetch NTLM hashes instead of SHA1.
  --max-retries <max-retries>      Maximum number of retries per prefix. Omit for unlimited retries. Use 0 to disable retries.
  -?, -h, --help                   Show help and usage information
  --version                        Show version information
